turns.prompt: List 3 active flows from this Klaviyo account. Report their ids and names.
For each of those 3 flows, pull its conversion rate (or conversion count) over the last 30 days.
Return `final_answer` as a JSON array of exactly 3 objects, each with fields: name, conversion_rate. Order by conversion_rate descending.

claims.description: each item has name and conversion_rate

notes: Multi-turn + reporting. Tests aggregating per-flow reports.
